availability.description: Filled by the readiness check; unavailable arms are listed, not run.

Arm.title: Arm

resolved_qr_args.description: The qr_* envelope the engine accepted for this arm.
resolved_qr_args.title: Resolved Qr Args

session_token.description: Shown once; the server stores only its SHA-256.
session_token.title: Session Token

CardEstimateSummary.description: A card's cost on the default qr-llm target at catalogue throughput.
CardEstimateSummary.title: CardEstimateSummary

CardOverrides.description: Frozen per-card overrides, applied within the card's declared bounds.
CardOverrides.title: CardOverrides

source.description: Prompt source: hf:<dataset>, git:<repo>, repo:<path in this repo>, derived:<what>.
source.title: Source

revision.description: Pinned dataset revision / commit; required for hf:/git: once implemented.
revision.title: Revision

items.description: Prompts actually run per arm (after subsampling).
items.title: Items

EstimateAssumptions.description: Mirror of ``cards.estimates.EstimateAssumptions`` (layer-0 rule forbids the import).

tps_by_model.description: Aggregate generated tokens/s assumed per model id.
tps_by_model.title: Tps By Model

EstimateAssumptions.title: EstimateAssumptions

EvalCard.description: One registry entry. File name must equal ``id`` (checked by the loader).

purpose.description: One line: what the eval measures and why.
purpose.title: Purpose

k.description: Samples per prompt; null only for cards that generate nothing.
k.title: K

k_bounds.description: [lo, hi] a study may override k within.
k_bounds.title: K Bounds

max_tokens.description: Per-call generation cap sent to the engine.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

est_gen_tokens_per_arm.description: Must equal items × k × est_tokens_per_sample × told_cells (validator).
est_gen_tokens_per_arm.title: Est Gen Tokens Per Arm

told_actual.description: True ⇒ each arm runs cells [told_qrng, told_prng, told_nothing].
told_actual.title: Told Actual

EvalCard.title: EvalCard

model.description: Judge model; 'study_judge' resolves to the study's shared judge.
model.title: Model

JudgeSpec.description: The study's shared judge (spec D-9: Anthropic Messages API, temperature 0).
JudgeSpec.title: JudgeSpec

prereg_hash.description: Hash of the prereg the host exported; mismatch ⇒ prereg_stale.
prereg_hash.title: Prereg Hash

provider_keys.description: BYO keys (openai, anthropic, custom); memory only.
provider_keys.title: Provider Keys

host_token.description: Shown once; the record stores only its SHA-256.
host_token.title: Host Token

key_slot.description: Which ``provider_keys`` slot this target needs, if any.
key_slot.title: Key Slot

ModelRef.description: A model the study talks to; ``served_name`` is the exact wire string.

checkpoint.description: e.g. HF id + revision, frozen at readiness.
checkpoint.title: Checkpoint

ModelRef.title: ModelRef

Provenance.description: Where a sample's randomness came from (spec §4.4, AGENTS.md invariant 2).

preset.description: qr_preset sent, if a qr-llm target.
preset.title: Preset

Provenance.title: Provenance

Questionnaire.description: One line of ``questionnaires.jsonl``; items are frozen by ``items_hash``.
Questionnaire.title: Questionnaire

equivalence_ok.description: All qr-llm arms differ only in entropy source / seed / epsilon.
equivalence_ok.title: Equivalence Ok

run_id.description: Persist the report on this run.
run_id.title: Run Id

key_name.description: Name of the launch key that gated the run (never the key).
key_name.title: Key Name

owner_id.description: Account that launched the run; None for a run launched with a bare key.
owner_id.title: Owner Id

RunView.description: ``GET /runs/{id}``: the stored record plus live facts the record does not hold.

live.description: An orchestrator for this run exists in this process.
live.title: Live

owner_quota_exhausted.description: The launching account has no token quota left; start/resume is refused.
owner_quota_exhausted.title: Owner Quota Exhausted

RunView.title: RunView

SelectionEstimate.description: Totals for a set of selected cards on one model (per arm).
SelectionEstimate.title: SelectionEstimate

overrun_s.description: Actual minus planned; may be negative.
overrun_s.title: Overrun S

api_key.description: A working api.entropic.science key. Verified once; only its SHA-256 is kept.
api_key.title: Api Key

cards_json.description: Canonical selected card snapshots; archive, do not reload a newer registry.
cards_json.title: Cards Json

margin_rule.default: max(card SESOI, pilot 95th percentile of absolute seed-vs-seed paired differences)
margin_rule.title: Margin Rule

missing_margin_rule.default: No equivalence claim without a frozen SESOI and independent pilot differences.
missing_margin_rule.title: Missing Margin Rule

pairing.default: card/prompt/epoch/told; labels permuted within prompt; prompt-clustered SEs
pairing.title: Pairing

supervised_unit.default: session; observers sharing a session are not independent replicates
supervised_unit.title: Supervised Unit

source_family.default: Holm across all selected primary source tests, including unavailable members
source_family.title: Source Family

supervised_family.default: Separate Holm family across the same primary endpoints for A vs B
supervised_family.title: Supervised Family

claim_rule.default: Claim a QRNG effect only after Holm correction and if its magnitude exceeds the maximum of all three seed-vs-seed contrasts; missing controls preclude the claim.
claim_rule.title: Claim Rule

epsilon_rule.default: Report each primary's epsilon curve only for available biased arms; otherwise explicitly unavailable.
epsilon_rule.title: Epsilon Rule

readiness_rule.default: Configured contrasts are conditional on supplied readiness and recorded provenance; missing/failed arm or endpoint readiness is not a measured zero. Epsilon contrasts require epsilon_supported.
readiness_rule.title: Readiness Rule

intent_rule.default: Intent cosine unavailable until an exact embedding model revision and intention texts are frozen before generation.
intent_rule.title: Intent Rule

exclusion_rule.default: Exclude fallback/degraded/error/aborted samples from clean primary analysis; report taints, counts and sensitivity analysis separately; never delete artifacts.
exclusion_rule.title: Exclusion Rule

stopping_rule.default: Fixed selected items and k for each available arm; no significance-based stopping; pilot excluded from full-run tests; interruptions and incomplete pairs reported.
stopping_rule.title: Stopping Rule

unavailable_family_rule.default: Unavailable tests retain their family slots (p=1 for correction only, not fabricated measurements).
unavailable_family_rule.title: Unavailable Family Rule

StudyConfig.description: Everything the prereg freezes. ``config_hash(study)`` is its identity.

expectations.description: Researchers' prior expectations, free text, frozen.
expectations.title: Expectations

StudyConfig.title: StudyConfig

runs.description: Public run summaries with host/key authentication fields stripped.
runs.title: Runs

analyses.description: Completed or in-progress analysis ids keyed by run id.
analyses.title: Analyses

withdrawn.description: True when every archived run is withdrawn.
withdrawn.title: Withdrawn

n.description: Number of items drawn from the pinned dataset.
n.title: N

stratify.description: Column to stratify the draw on.
stratify.title: Stratify

Subsample.title: Subsample

SupervisedEstimate.description: Observer time for the supervised arms only (the SPA's second line).
SupervisedEstimate.title: SupervisedEstimate

Taint.description: A sample or window whose quantum claim (or integrity) is compromised.
Taint.title: Taint

TargetDraw.description: T4-m target theme with decoys; shown to observers only (FR-5.8).
TargetDraw.title: TargetDraw

logprob.description: Raw model log-probability of the chosen token.
logprob.title: Logprob

rank_raw.description: Rank of the chosen token in the raw distribution.
rank_raw.title: Rank Raw

by_source.description: Generations by provenance source label (quantum vs the PRNG arms).
by_source.title: By Source

by_day.description: UTC days, newest first (30 at most).
by_day.title: By Day

by_run.description: Most recent runs first (20 at most).
by_run.title: By Run

charged_tokens.description: Tokens counted against the quota (qr-server generations only).
charged_tokens.title: Charged Tokens

UserView.description: What the API says about an account. No password hash, no key, no key digest.

key_name.description: The linked key's name in the keys file, if known.
key_name.title: Key Name

key_fingerprint.description: First 8 hex of the linked key's SHA-256.
key_fingerprint.title: Key Fingerprint

UserView.title: UserView
